description.value: You have a few pieces of devilish magic at your disposal. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Divine Lance] as a divine innate spell at will, heightened to half your level rounded up. Additionally, you can cast 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Fear] and 2nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Spiritual Armament] as divine innate spells once per day each. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Invoke Infernal Potency] action.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
